title: JJK Characters
description: How well do you know the cast of Jujutsu Kaisen?

questions.question: Where is Yuji Itadori originally from?
questions.explanation: Yuji grew up in Sendai with his grandfather Wasuke.

questions.question: What is Nobara Kugisaki's preferred weapon?
questions.explanation: Nobara channels cursed energy through nails she drives into targets with a hammer.

questions.question: Megumi Fushiguro's surname Fushiguro comes from his mother's side.
questions.explanation: Toji took the Fushiguro name from his wife when leaving the Zenin clan.

questions.question: Who is Maki Zenin's twin sister?
questions.explanation: Mai Zenin is Maki's twin, born with cursed energy unlike Maki.

questions.question: Which Kyoto student wields a sword named Playful Cloud?
questions.explanation: Playful Cloud is actually a three-section staff cursed tool wielded by Todo.

questions.question: Kasumi Miwa specializes in a Simple Domain technique called New Shadow Style.
questions.explanation: Miwa learned the New Shadow Style: Simple Domain from Hakari and others to counter domains.

questions.question: What is Yuta Okkotsu's relationship to Satoru Gojo?

options.text: Cousin via the Gojo branch family

questions.explanation: Yuta is a distant relative of Gojo, descending from Sugawara no Michizane.

questions.question: Which character is the principal of Kyoto Jujutsu High?
questions.explanation: Gakuganji leads Kyoto Jujutsu High and conspires with conservative higher-ups.

questions.question: Choso considers Yuji Itadori his younger brother.
questions.explanation: Choso's death-painting brothers are tied to Yuji through Kenjaku's experiments on Yuji's mother.

questions.question: Which character is the Number 1 grade sorcerer beside Gojo?
questions.explanation: Yuki Tsukumo is one of the four special-grade jujutsu sorcerers along with Gojo, Yuta, and Geto.
